_about: One row per handheld. Matched on DMI ids (/sys/class/dmi/id). 'support': full = tested on the device by us, partial = matched from tested upstream data (InputPlumber, steamos-manager, PowerStation, Handheld Daemon) but not tested by us, generic = matched but mostly guessed. Power ranges in watts. 'profiles': watts (TDP = PL1) for the battery / balanced / performance profiles; rows without it get a spread of their range. 'pl2_offset_w': boost limit PL2 = TDP + this (Intel). 'tdp_backends': which power services to try, in order (default steamos-manager, then powerstation). 'fixes': root fixes offered on this device, each the name of a folder in fixes/ (as `gamecove-fix --list` prints it); charge-limit and fan are driven by 'charge_limit' and 'fan' instead (docs/CONTRACTS.md, Root actions). Field reference: docs/DEVICES.md.
_schema: docs/DEVICES.md describes every field. 'tier': specific beats family; unknown hardware gets a generic row built from the CPU ('cpus' below). 'match': one object or a list of objects; every key in an object must match (glob patterns, case-insensitive), any object may match. 'verified': false when any value in 'unverified' is a best guess.

devices.name: Steam Deck (LCD)
quirks: Steam Deck controller is a HID device; InputPlumber's deck driver exposes L4/L5/R4/R5 as paddles and both trackpads.
notes: TDP max 15 W is Valve's limit; SimpleDeckyTDP (aarron-lee/SimpleDeckyTDP@ab0128f) lets the slider reach 20 W - devices.json keeps 15 W.

devices.name: Steam Deck (OLED)
quirks: Panel runs 45-90 Hz; gamescope handles refresh switching.
notes: TDP max 15 W is Valve's limit; SimpleDeckyTDP (aarron-lee/SimpleDeckyTDP@ab0128f) lets the slider reach 20 W - devices.json keeps 15 W.

devices.name: ASUS ROG Ally
quirks: TDP through the asus-armoury firmware attributes (steamos-manager); older kernels only have asus-wmi ppt_* files.
Fan curves live in the asus_custom_fan_curve hwmon (GameCove's fan fix); changing the platform profile puts the factory curve back.
notes: Boost limits follow Handheld Daemon's ASUS rule: hhd-dev/hhd@6f6045a src/adjustor/drivers/asus/__init__.py L51-53, L370-380: FPPT = min(max(SPL, 35), SPL*35/25), SPPT = min(max(SPL, 35), SPL*30/25).

devices.name: ASUS ROG Xbox Ally
quirks: steamos-manager drives TDP through amdgpu hwmon (4-20 W) on this model.
notes: Boost limits: hhd-dev/hhd@6f6045a core/const.py L299-312 XBOX_ALLY_DATA (max 20 W, 'SPPT 20 FPPT 25', OC 25 W) with the ASUS rule (asus/__init__.py L51-53).

devices.name: ASUS ROG Xbox Ally X
notes: boost_max 45 -> 35 W: hhd-dev/hhd@6f6045a core/const.py L314-327 XBOX_ALLYX_DATA has max 35 W and the ASUS rule caps SPPT/FPPT at max(SPL, 35) = 35 W. ASUS documents no higher manual-mode figure (rog.asus.com 'How to boost gaming performance on the ROG Ally or ROG Xbox Ally' gives no watt limits); hhd's 50 W 'OC' is opt-in and not a safe default.

devices.name: ASUS ROG Xbox Ally X20

notes: min 5 -> 7 W and boost_max 45 -> 35 W: hhd-dev/hhd@6f6045a core/const.py L349 ASUS_DATA['ROG XBOX Ally X RC74X'] = XBOX_ALLYX_DATA with min_tdp 7; boost per the ASUS rule (asus/__init__.py L51-53, L370-380).

devices.name: Lenovo Legion Go
quirks: Detachable controllers: gyro and buttons come from whichever halves are attached.
TDP through lenovo-wmi-other firmware attributes in Lenovo's 'custom' mode (steamos-manager, kernel 6.17+); older kernels need hhd/acpi_call.
Panel has no VRR; it switches between 60 and 144 Hz.
notes: Boost limits: hhd-dev/hhd@6f6045a src/adjustor/drivers/lenovo/__init__.py L62-66, L302-311 (go): SPPT = SPL + 2, at most 32 W; FPPT = min(41, SPL*41/30). Legion Space allows SPPT up to 41 W in custom mode on some BIOSes; 32 W is kept as the ceiling.

devices.name: MSI Claw 8 EX AI+
devices._tdp_backends_why: steamos-manager offers TdpLimit1 here through the msi-wmi-platform firmware attributes, but the firmware ignores them (ClawDeck, measured 2026-10-21); PowerStation writes intel-rapl-mmio, which caps package power exactly. PowerStation reports MinTdp = MaxTdp = 0 for Panther Lake, so the range above is used.
quirks: MSI buttons need the claw8ex-buttons fix on older InputPlumber.
VRR floor is 48 Hz until the claw8ex-vrr fix.
Gyro needs the sensor-hub firmware (claw8ex-gyro fix).

devices.name: MSI Claw A8
notes: Boost limits: hhd-dev/hhd@6f6045a src/adjustor/drivers/msi/__init__.py L161-176, L375-389 and core/const.py CLAW_*_DATA: SPPT = SPL*max_tdp_sppt/max_tdp, capped (CLAW_8A_DATA: max 35, SPPT 40, FPPT 48).
